finding: Publisher writes h.next before lock, links queue under mutex, unlocks then raises interrupt using target PSTATE and select-abort
hazard: Closing only queue link leaves post-unlock PSTATE writes or native device wakeup outstanding
proposedReplacement: Publication lease begins before header effect and ends after wakeup; close producer admission, preserve exact target incarnation

finding: Service removes head and updates tail under mutex, unlocks before execute_fn(intr,true)
hazard: Queue empty while callback claimed or executing; no current active-call registry in this route
proposedReplacement: Publish claim under same exclusion as dequeue before unlocking; close gate wins or registered claim remains owed

finding: Cleanup walks queue and invokes execute_fn(intr,false) while queue mutex held
hazard: Calling Scheme or reentrant enqueue under lock can wait on this GC or same lock
proposedReplacement: Detach admitted release duties under lock; execute later with explicit effect/owner profile, not guessed cancellation semantics

finding: Init accepts arbitrary execute_fn; GSTATE exports init/raise interface
hazard: Local queue code cannot prove external producer quiescence, borrowed payload stability or true/false operation equivalence
proposedReplacement: Typed origin/effect/result manifest and unregister/drain or owned queue exclusion; refuse unregistered raw origins

finding: Native closure writes global c_closure_self before generated converter; RC payload stores Scheme proc
hazard: Gate solely inside ___call is after raw ingress effect/root read; cached function pointer survives logical generation change
proposedReplacement: Stable typed native entry thunk and metadata/code lease before first relevant effect; qualify global/TLS closure identity redesign

finding: Generated callback fetches PSTATE, allocates marker, converts parameters, calls Scheme and may retry handler
hazard: Late gate after BEGIN_SFUN already touched owner context and roots
proposedReplacement: Generate admission/epoch/owner ticket before PSTATE-dependent conversions and marker allocation; preserve result ABI

finding: make_marker allocates vector before copying proc; source root TODO remains; kill clears then refcount decrements
hazard: Future queue metadata alone does not protect movable input or keep native frame valid
proposedReplacement: VM root handle before marker allocation, fresh root reload after GC, retained native activation for parked path

finding: scheme_call_cmd calls tcltk_call synchronously and immediately installs returned char string into Tcl
hazard: Returning pending/success while Scheme result not computed changes command semantics; argv strings borrowed from native call
proposedReplacement: No blanket task deferral; upstream host initiation gate or participating same-call wait, with separate result/input ownership

finding: Delete callback releases Scheme object and RC client_data; result release later invokes Gambit release_string
hazard: Deletion or wrapper refcount alone is no proof every copied/native invocation pointer has drained
proposedReplacement: Native library origin lifetime evidence plus wrapper active leases; result and client_data custody survive deletion until actual borrower drain

finding: Strong/weak/cleanup barriers and P0 resize precede per-PSTATE continuation prep; P0 raises INTR_GC before prepare_mem_pstate
hazard: GC notification is not proof all context/root/phase gates ready for external reentry
proposedReplacement: Coordinator canonical whole-round result and participant preparation receipts before next epoch publish; no current gate issuer inferred

finding: prepare_mem_pstate writes fp/hp and stack/heap limits, refreshes interrupt limits; heap fudge can acquire next msection
hazard: A root-safe task still cannot use old allocators/context limits after GC
proposedReplacement: Bind next context incarnation/capacity outcome and reload roots before claim authorizes any managed allocation

finding: Per-PSTATE RC payloads; mark_rc occurs in P0 branch; continuation/register/saved roots scanned per processor
hazard: Transferred nonzero roots or native-held closure cannot be inferred covered from current P0 scan
proposedReplacement: All-domain VM root registry and frozen parked view, stable handles with post-copy reload; preserve independent RC and still ownership

finding: thread_set_pstate sets binding/TLS and affinity; startup attaches owner before execution
hazard: Processor integer/TLS pointer alone is not next-epoch permission or native activation identity
proposedReplacement: Exact VM/context/native-thread incarnation binding and fresh permission; unknown/mismatched owner refuses entry

finding: ___call and return handler preserve native marker/catcher return rights; wrong processor or repeat return rejected
hazard: Parked same call cannot be replayed as a fresh task or jumped by worker thread
proposedReplacement: Participating wait keeps catcher/continuation roots/native stack live; resume same invocation under new write lease

finding: PSTATE cleanup destroys still/RC/OS resources; shrink joins later and ignores result; VM destroys shared scan facilities
hazard: Future task or parked native borrower may outlive source; failed/unknown join does not authorize code/context free
proposedReplacement: Canonical VM custody and source borrower closure before data cleanup; retain native envelope on unknown stop

finding: Public native callback/marker/interrupt functions and real c-define callbacks expose entry capabilities
hazard: Swapping pointer or emptying owned queue cannot revoke cached foreign pointer or already-issued machine invocation
proposedReplacement: Complete loaded origin/entry manifest, early stable thunk and transport exclusion receipt; unknown alias keeps qualification open
